acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: A terminal lane cannot retain the control-checkout dispatch lease after successful closeout.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Canonical control-root resolution and release-before-terminal-write ordering are executed by focused filesystem regressions.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: A terminal persistence failure cannot strand a mismatched lease state.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: The failed manifest-write regression asserts byte-for-byte restoration of the original active lease.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Closeout retry is idempotent and can recover a hosted terminal transition locally.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Released/reclaimed leases are not rewritten, and already-done finalize plans replay terminal cleanup before reconciliation even when journaled complete.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Truth surfaces refuse a done lane that still holds scope.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: M8 fails done plus active or stale-reclaim-required and passes done plus released or missing.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Wrong-base repair cannot silently restore an invalidated PR binding.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Repair returns named pr_base_mismatch before inference for the blocker and before reachability for wrong or unresolved inferred bases.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: R1/R2 applicability cannot be executor self-declared.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: The production truth-check path paginates GitHub PR files and records the classified repository list; only all-control-plane scope is not_applicable, while mixed, missing, and ambiguous scope fails closed.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Non-lane PR branches do not receive a false red lane-binding check.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: The workflow compares the manifest branch before bind=true and exits 0 with bind=false on mismatch while retaining trusted branch/base validation for registered lanes.

known_limitations: The local checkout is not authorized for writable staging DB verification; PR CI must supply the isolated staging receipt.
The invariant is enforced at the done transition. A merged lane remains eligible to hold its lease until lane-close performs the terminal transition.
Database reachability for scripts/** classification is followed one import hop; a reach of two or more hops is classified control-plane (7 files across scripts/{ci,ops}, all proof-tooling chains).
Marker matching is textual over comment-stripped source, not AST-derived.
.github/workflows/lane-pr-binding.yml has no mechanical test coverage; its no-op branches are verified by inspection only.
